name: Shibuya
tagline: Shibuya in 1 minute and Shinjuku in 5 minutes. Served by 10 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, served by JR Yamanote Line, JR Saikyo Line, Narita Express, JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line, Keio Inokashira Line, Tokyu Toyoko Line, Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line, Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line and Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 19 minutes to Otemachi, 5 minutes to Shinjuku, 1 minute to Shibuya and 21 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 15.1 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 20.7 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 15.1 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 10.6 m to 31.3 m, a difference of 20.7 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 26 clinics and 24 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 衣笠眼科, about 95 m away and 湘南美容外科, about 207 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 10 lines serve the station: JR Yamanote Line, JR Saikyo Line, Narita Express, JR Shonan-Shinjuku Line, Keio Inokashira Line, Tokyu Toyoko Line, Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line, Tokyo Metro Ginza Line, Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line and Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 4 lines, Keio runs 1 line, Tokyu runs 2 lines and Tokyo Metro runs 3 lines), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 100.

rentRange.note: One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1LDK ¥270,000 to ¥280,000 and 2LDK ¥460,000 to ¥470,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: 741 m away in a straight line. It takes 7 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shibuya.
1183 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 3 minutes sooner than Shibuya.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
notFor: People who would rather not walk up and down slopes
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: The 首都高速3号渋谷線 viaduct runs 140 m away. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
明治通り (a main road) runs 94 m away. Morning and evening, the cars are audible indoors

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 10 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make: 首都高速3号渋谷線 runs 140 m away.
